D02.slot: kappa^2 hh two-point (part of the hh slot with D01, D03 -- D01/D03 NOT evaluated in p15)

regulated_expression.form: iGamma_1 = N_eps * (-kappa**2/2) * sum_comp [ sum_k c_k(d, p, Gt) J_D02[k,0] ],  J_D02[k,0] = int (l^2)^k / (l^2 + i0)

D02.UV_subtraction: none: no 1/eps pole (every member is a pure power divergence, omega > 0); MS-bar counterterm 0
D02.local_ambiguity: none generated in the declared prescription; the kappa^2 hh slot's local freedom is the p14r h.h counterterm directions (degree 4 in p) and is NOT touched by D02/D12 (no pole, no finite local term)
D02.renormalization_conditions: MS-bar at mu (P14 normalization condition 0) + N4 (no mu^4, mu^2 p^2 contacts); no counterterm is required

S0_applications.class: UV power divergence Lambda^2: no pole on either side at d = 4
UV power divergence Lambda^4: no pole on either side at d = 4

scaleless_analysis.UV_IR_reading: no member is logarithmic (omega = 0): the DR zero is NOT a 1/eps_UV - 1/eps_IR cancellation here; it discards pure power divergences (omega = 2, 4); the IR region converges at d = 4 and neither the UV nor the IR part has a pole at d = 4

IR_regulator_mass.rule: 1/(l^2 + i0) -> 1/(l^2 - m^2 + i0) on the loop line (analysis only; m is not in the action)
IR_regulator_mass.limit_m_to_0: 0 (pole ~ m^{2j}, finite ~ m^{2j}(a + b log m^2), j >= 1)
IR_regulator_mass.counterterm_needed_at_finite_m: poles ~ kappa^2 m^4 hh and kappa^2 m^2 p^2 hh: order-0/order-2 contacts, OUTSIDE the p14r h.h basis (excluded by N4); they vanish as m -> 0

prescription_dependence.analytic_regulator: (l^2)^{-1-nu}: the integrand stays scaleless for every nu, the value stays 0; an analytic regulator alone does not separate UV from IR here
prescription_dependence.cutoff_split: each member splits into IR (+Lambda^omega/omega...) and UV (-Lambda^omega/omega...) pieces with no pole at d = 4; with a hard cutoff the would-be counterterms are kappa^2 Lambda^4 hh and kappa^2 Lambda^2 p^2 hh (order 0/2: excluded by N4, not p14r directions)
